Blue are one of the most successful British boybands of all time. After starting out in 2000, the group soon became a top seller in the UK and shot to worldwide fame with their first single All Rise, which is still a huge hit on radio stations. Their collaboration with Elton John on a remake of his hit Sorry Seems to Be The Hardest Word was also an international top seller. The group went on a hiatus in 2004 but returned a few years later. Blue have now sold more than 15 million albums worldwide. Their new record, Heart & Soul, was released on 28 October 2022.
